name: How long does ceiling painting usually take?
description: A standard room may take one day, but repairs, tall ceilings, or extra coats can add time.

mainEntity.name: How long does ceiling painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a typical room, ceiling painting can often be completed in **a day**, but larger rooms, tall ceilings, repairs, or drying time can extend the project. If the ceiling needs stain blocking, patching, or multiple coats, plan for more time.
